messages:
rachel: quick alert — nightly RBAC migration rolled an identity rename and now our premerge SARIF uploads fail with token exchange errors. several PRs blocked. anyone from IAM awake?

sam: that was my migration. i renamed group infra-scanners -> scanners-team to consolidate memberships. bindings were reapplied, but maybe the impersonation chain relied on the old group identity string.

priya: CI excerpt from the sarif-uploader job:
```
ERROR: upload failed
cause: iam.credentials.generateAccessToken: PermissionDenied
detail: caller does not have permission to impersonate serviceAccount:scanner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
uploader: exit code 2
```

iam-bot: audit event: principal=sam@redwood.com action=iam.setIamPolicy resource=projects/redwood/serviceAccounts/scanner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com timestamp=2025-12-01T07:09:12Z audit_id=AL-20251201-0710. note: group rename applied in policy delta: member:"group:scanners-team@redwood.com" added, member:"group:infra-scanners@redwood.com" removed.

rachel: thanks. security needs the full audit export for the window 2025-12-01T06:50:00Z..2025-12-01T07:20:00Z — i don't see iam.credentials logs because our export filter was narrowed last quarter. can we pull raw audit logs?

sam: i'll re-add the old group membership as a short-lived mitigation while we fix the mapping. prefer ephemeral fix over full rollback.

scanner-bot: ephemeral impersonation grant created: grant_id=G-7745 principal=group:infra-scanners@redwood.com role=roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator expires=2025-12-01T08:10:00Z.

priya: re-running blocked CI now.

devops-bot: rerun results: 12/14 jobs green, 2 failing for unrelated unit-test flakes. SARIF uploads succeeded after grant.

rachel: mitigation confirmed. follow-ups: 1) update RBAC runbook to cover group renames and service-account impersonation chains, 2) add an automated smoke job that impersonates any SA touched by an IAM diff before merge, 3) reconfigure audit-export to include iam.credentials.* and allow backfill, 4) make SARIF suppression matching resilient to missing uploads (fingerprint fallback).

sam: opened infra#710 with proposed changes: smoke-impersonate job, group->sa mapping terraform, and audit export filter patch. please review.

sec-bot: incident ticket SEC-2025-945 created. linked resources: AL-20251201-0710, G-7745, infra#710. suggested sev: low-medium.

rachel: add a note in the postmortem: owner of suppression entries must be notified when their SARIF artifacts fail to upload for >1hour so we don't auto-expire suppressions silently.

sam: agreed. i'll also add a CI preflight that runs `gcloud iam service-accounts get-iam-policy` and a local impersonation `gcloud iam service-accounts impersonate --format=json` check as part of the keystore/iam change flow.

priya: once infra#710 is merged, i'll schedule a backfill job to re-run SARIF collector for the impacted PRs and update suppression mappings.

rachel: thanks everyone. marking mitigated while infra#710 is reviewed and merged. will draft the short postmortem and attach audit export + grant id.
